_comment: Per-1M-token USD prices. User-editable. Used to compute cost_usd per attempt. Update as vendor pricing changes.

_pricing_notes.claude-fable-5: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — 2x opus-4-7 rates. Requires authoritative pricing confirmation from Anthropic before production use.
_pricing_notes.claude-opus-5: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — carried over from claude-opus-4-7 rates. Requires authoritative pricing confirmation from Anthropic before production use.
_pricing_notes.claude-sonnet-5: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — carried over from claude-sonnet-4-6 rates. Requires authoritative pricing confirmation from Anthropic before production use.
_pricing_notes.gpt-5.6-terra: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — gpt-5.5 rates. Requires authoritative pricing confirmation from OpenAI before production use.
_pricing_notes.gpt-5.6-luna: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — gpt-5.5 rates. Requires authoritative pricing confirmation from OpenAI before production use.
_pricing_notes.gpt-5.6-sol: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — gpt-5.1-codex-max rates, the highest OpenAI rate on file. Requires authoritative pricing confirmation from OpenAI before production use.
_pricing_notes.gemini-3.7-flash-*: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER — added 2026-09-01 with the E2-1 re-pin. Requires authoritative pricing confirmation from Google before production cost reporting is trusted.
_pricing_notes.gemini-3.1-pro-preview: RETIRED as a pin 2026-09-01 (E2-1) — the installed Antigravity CLI no longer serves this id. The rate is RETAINED so archived attempt rows still price correctly on /pp:replay.
_pricing_notes._legacy_retained: gpt-5.4, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-max, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-6, gemini-3.1-pro-preview are intentionally RETAINED after the gpt-5.6 / Claude-5 repin and the E2-1 agy repin so archived attempt rows still price correctly on /pp:replay. computeCost() looks up by literal model id and silently returns 0 on a miss — never delete a key that appears in a historical attempt row.
